record.paper_title: Open Problems in Heavy Quarkonium Physics
record.original_question: What theoretical mechanism can explain the unexpectedly large double-charmonium production rates observed by Belle in e+e− annihilation, particularly for inclusive J/ψ + c c̄ and exclusive J/ψ + ηc final states, whose measured cross sections are nearly an order of magnitude larger than available predictions? The paper notes that the Belle upper bound on J/ψ + J/ψ remains compatible with theory, so the open problem is to identify what ingredient is missing in the theoretical description of the channels that disagree with data and whether a genuinely new production mechanism is required.

artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent theoretical work has largely closed the gap between predictions and the Belle/BaBar measurements for e⁺e⁻ → J/ψ + η_c without invoking a fundamentally new production mechanism. Including next-to-leading-order and next-to-next-to-leading-order QCD corrections within NRQCD factorization, together with relativistic corrections, light-cone distribution amplitude resummation, and improved renormalization-scale setting (e.g., the Principle of Maximum Conformality), brings the predicted exclusive cross section into agreement with experiment within uncertainties. The inclusive J/ψ + cc̄ channel has likewise been brought closer to data by NLO color-singlet plus color-octet contributions. Thus the problem is widely regarded as substantially resolved within standard QCD/NRQCD, though residual theoretical uncertainties (scale dependence, convergence, double-logarithms) keep parts of the problem under active study.

status_evidence.title: Next-to-next-to-leading-order QCD corrections to e+e- → J/ψ + η_c at B factories
status_evidence.snippet: NRQCD factorization holds at NNLO for exclusive double charmonium production; NNLO QCD corrections considerably reduce renormalization scale dependence and yield reasonable perturbative convergence.
status_evidence.claim: NNLO QCD corrections within NRQCD largely resolve the discrepancy between theory and the Belle/BaBar measurement of e+e- → J/ψ + η_c.

status_evidence.title: Exclusive production of J/ψ + η_c at the B factories Belle and BABAR using the principle of maximum conformality
status_evidence.snippet: Predictions at NLO are sensitive to the renormalization scale; applying the Principle of Maximum Conformality eliminates the discrepancy with the measured cross sections.
status_evidence.claim: Proper renormalization-scale setting (PMC) brings NRQCD predictions into agreement with the measured exclusive cross section.

status_evidence.title: Is the BELLE result for the cross section e+e- → J/psi + eta_c a real difficulty for QCD?
status_evidence.snippet: Early analysis arguing the discrepancy may not signal a breakdown of QCD once higher-order and relativistic effects are included.
status_evidence.claim: Early theoretical responses pointed to higher-order/relativistic corrections rather than a new mechanism.
